name: guide_metadata
title: Guide metadata (IGVF guide library, pools A-D)
description: Canonical guide library used across the production datasets that share the full TF library (Hon CM, Huangfu DE, Huangfu ES, Gersbach hepatocyte). This schema describes the file as it is published on the IGVF portal — we do not modify or simplify it; consumers should read it directly from the portal URL.
scope_decision: Pool A-D only. Some datasets (Hon CM, Gersbach hepatocyte) used an additional pool F in the actual experiment, but only the pool A-D library is mirrored to the jamboree because (a) it is the canonical released library on the IGVF portal and (b) pool F adds only a small additional set of targets. Pool F guide details, if needed, can be derived from `tf_perturb_seq/ref/finalized_annotation_files/harmonized_guide_file_poolf_ensg.tsv`.

fields.name: targeting
fields.description: Whether the guide is intended to target a genomic locus (TRUE for targeting / positive controls / negative controls; FALSE for non-targeting).

fields.name: guide_chr
fields.description: Chromosome of the guide cut site.

fields.name: genomic_element
fields.description: Annotation of the targeted element (e.g., promoter).

fields.name: intended_target_name
fields.description: Ensembl gene ID (ENSG...) of the intended target.

fields.name: intended_target_chr
fields.description: Chromosome of the intended target locus.

fields.name: intended_target_start
fields.description: Start coordinate of the intended target locus.

fields.name: intended_target_end
fields.description: End coordinate of the intended target locus.

fields.name: putative_target_genes
fields.description: Other genes that may be affected (free-text).

fields.name: gene_name
fields.description: Gene symbol of the intended target.
